title: A Recipe for the Detention
premise: Emrys Fairweather, seventeen, has spent senior year as surrogate parent to three siblings while their mother works hospital nights, treating graduation as a release date. When culinary teacher Ms. Okafor pairs Emrys with rival Theo Vance for a semester-long community cookbook project, the two discover their families share a tangled history: their late fathers were business partners whose falling-out splintered both households. As the cookbook project spirals into a regional cooking competition, Emrys and Theo must decide whether winning the championship that doesn't matter is worth exposing the truth about the one that does — the custody question hanging over Emrys's family. At the spring showcase, Emrys chooses family over victory, confessing the sabotage they committed to protect their siblings, and finds that honesty — and Theo — might be the first recipe for a life they actually want.
about_author: Juniper Sandoval grew up above her family's bakery in a coastal mill town, where she learned that every recipe is really a story about who fed you. She writes young adult novels about loud kitchens, quiet kids, and the families we build when the ones we're given crack.

chapters.title: Sentence Structure
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. A chaotic morning — burnt toast, missing permission slips, a seven-year-old's meltdown — establishes Emrys as parent-sibling counting down to graduation. At school, Ms. Okafor announces the semester project and pairs Emrys with Theo Vance, the golden-boy rival. Emotional beat: resentment hardening into dread.

chapters.title: Nemesis, Meet Kitchen
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Forced to plan the project together, Theo is startled when Emrys's little sister wanders into their meeting and Emrys switches seamlessly into caretaker mode — a side of Emrys no one at school sees. Emotional beat: curiosity cracking open old contempt.

chapters.title: The Vance Family Recipe Box
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. Researching family recipes, Emrys finds a photo of their late father with Theo's father — former partners in a restaurant that burned down. Emrys hides it. Meanwhile, Mom's custody worry about the younger siblings surfaces. Emotional beat: the past pressing on the present.

chapters.title: Promises in Parchment
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Theo discovers the same photo and realizes Emrys knew first, feeling betrayed. A blowup in the school kitchen ends with both admitting they're scared — of the truth, of their families, of each other's expectations. Emotional beat: first honest collision.

chapters.title: Overtime
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. The competition entry requires a live showcase, forcing late-night practice sessions while Mom works doubles. Theo starts showing up with groceries, unasked. The younger siblings adopt Theo. Emotional beat: found family quietly assembling itself.

chapters.title: What the Fire Took
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. They interview a retired chef who witnessed the restaurant fire; the truth emerges — Emrys's father took the blame for a code violation that was partly Theo's father's fault, and died before clearing his name. Emotional beat: grief and fury entwined.

chapters.title: Sabotage Season
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. Desperate to shield the siblings from a custody investigation triggered by the reopened scandal, Emrys quietly alters the team's entry to a safer recipe and lies to Theo. Emotional beat: love curdling into secrecy.

chapters.title: The One That Doesn't Matter
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. At the regional semifinal, the tampered entry collapses; Theo realizes what Emrys did and walks out mid-service. Emrys places last, alone. Emotional beat: the championship that doesn't matter is lost, and it costs everything.

chapters.title: Prom, Custody, and Other Verdicts
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. The night before the custody hearing, Theo arrives at the Fairweather door with the original photo and a sworn statement from the retired chef — choosing Emrys over his own father's reputation. They go to prom for exactly one song. Emotional beat: love against duty, finally aligned.

chapters.title: A Recipe for Staying
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV, epilogue-adjacent. At the final showcase, Emrys tells the truth publicly instead of winning, and the family stays together; Theo's father, confronted, begins making amends. The cookbook is published with both family names on the cover. Emotional beat: graduation as a beginning, not a release.
